171.csv::0.source_text:
最近はやりの&amp;quot;副業&amp;quot;ていうの？
あれがなかなか好調なのよね
いっそのことそっちを本職にしちゃおうかしら
171.csv::0.translated_text:
You know those "side gigs" that are all the rage these days?
They're actually doing pretty well.
Maybe I should just make that my main job.
171.csv::0.speaker: Miranda

171.csv::1.source_text:
その合言葉を知っているということは
私の秘密のスイーツを買いに来たのね
あぁ、でもごめんなさい
今日はもう残り１つだけしかないの
171.csv::1.translated_text:
Since you know that password,
I guess you came to buy my secret treat.
Oh, but I'm sorry—
I only have one left today.
171.csv::1.speaker: Miranda

171.csv::2.source_text:
最近流行りのお祭りのせいかしらね
普段よりもよく売れるの
最後の１つだから特別にサービスするわ
またたくさん用意しておくから是非買いに来てね
171.csv::2.translated_text:
I wonder if it's because of the festival that's been so popular lately.
We're selling more than usual.
Since this is the last one, I'll give you a special deal.
I'll make sure to stock up again, so please come by and buy some.
171.csv::2.speaker: Miranda

171.csv::3.source_text:
どう？　森の妖精マカロンは美味しかった？
え、味見する分しかなかったの？
そっかー、すぐに売り切れちゃうんだよねー
171.csv::3.translated_text:
So, how was it? Did you like the Forest Fairy Macarons?
Huh, there was only enough for a taste?
Oh, I see—they always sell out so fast, don't they?
171.csv::3.speaker: Lise

171.csv::4.source_text:
ナイショの割にはとっても人気なんだもん
私もなかなか買えないの！
今度たくさん入荷した時は
一緒に買いにいこうね！
171.csv::4.translated_text:
It's surprisingly popular for something that's supposed to be a secret.
I can hardly ever get my hands on it either!
Next time they restock in bulk,
let's go buy some together!
171.csv::4.speaker: Lise

171.csv::5.source_text:
森の妖精マカロン、品切れだったのね
でも、味見はできたみたいでよかった！
どう？　とっても美味しかったでしょ？
うふふ――喜んでもらえたなら、嬉しいな
171.csv::5.translated_text:
The "Forest Fairy Macaron" was sold out, wasn't it?
But I'm glad you got to try a bite!
So, what did you think? It was really delicious, wasn't it?
Hehe—I'm so glad you enjoyed it!
171.csv::5.speaker: Mayleaf
